title: Battery cases, Italian and English
goal: A model's choice of battery tool, arguments and approval is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals 1 to 3 of the shared-asset review, solution:F-016-T05); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

Cases (when F-009 and F-012 register their tools) cover read tools, charge-state and resistance writes proposed for approval, colour series and several batteries in one phrase, Italian first: "carica le batterie 7 e 8 blu" and English equivalents; until the json-match grader is released (gauntlet-protocol:F-032) the cases ask for sorted ids
A test fails when a case names a tool that is not registered
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 10 to 14 cases, half Italian. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
